_format.note: Patient placements. Each patient is assigned to one room in the run (chosen at run start from the patient pool). Patient prose lives in data/voiceprose.json (subtitles + notes), unchanged. Each entry here has the species, the ambient effect on the surrounding rooms, and how the patient is observed.
_format.ambient_effects: noisy: any time you ACT in an adjacent room, there is a 25% chance the Attending hears, gaining 1 patrol bias toward your column. dread: looking into this room costs +1 file note unless you've seen them before. cold: you cannot HIDE in adjacent rooms. wandering: this patient occasionally appears one room over from their bed (rare, telegraphed). silent: no effect; the room reads as empty unless you LOOK closely.
_format.see_line: What you see when you LOOK into the room (short).

Emberkin.see_line: She is in the chair. The bed across from her is made.

Ashmaw.see_line: She is chewing. You cannot see what.

Cinderling.see_line: She is on the floor. She is listening for the porch.

Pyrelord.see_line: He is in his armchair. The chair is empty. He is in it.

Magmaw.see_line: He faces the door. He has been waiting for it to open. ~~It opens.~~

Soothlick.see_line: She is not here. The bed is **freshly tucked**.

Charnel.see_line: She is standing. She has not sat down in [[6]] days.

Tidewhelp.see_line: He is at the window. He is the brother. He is the patient.

Rivergeist.see_line: She is not here. The bed-rail has been bent open ~~again~~.

Brineback.see_line: He is in the bed. He has been here since the linens came in.

Mireling.see_line: She is asking about the pond. The pond is not on the floor plan.

Coralhusk.see_line: She turns her head. She does not say her name.

Frostfin.see_line: She is on the bench. The bench is in her room. The room is cold.

Deepmaw.see_line: She is below. The room smells of ~~the basement~~ wet stone.

Loamback.see_line: She is sitting. The wall clock says 1981.

Sproutkin.see_line: She is re-opening the bandage. The room smells of iron.

Mosshorn.see_line: He is at the window. He is at the bed. He is at the door.

Vinewyrm.see_line: She is in the corner. She is on the floor. She has not used the legs.

Bloomback.see_line: He is sitting up. He is **showing you** something growing.

Thornling.see_line: She is small. The wall behind her has [[3]] punctures.

Hollowoak.see_line: She is in the chair. She is asking after her daughter. The daughter is the next room.

Aurabeast.see_line: He is writing. The page is blank. He is writing in **your hand**.

Dawnstag.see_line: He is at the window. The window opens onto a room that is not on the plan.

Halowyrm.see_line: She is glowing. She is in the dark. The room is cold.

Glimmerfox.see_line: He is petting the floor. The floor is empty.

Shadowmaw.see_line: He is sitting up. He is saying ~~your~~ a name. Quietly.

Voidling.see_line: He is by the closet. The closet door is cracked. !!Something is breathing in there.!!

Nightcreep.see_line: She is not here. The chair is **warm**.

Wraithfin.see_line: She is in the bed. The other bed is also occupied. By her.

Umbragale.see_line: She is drawing on the wall. The drawing is **the door at the end of the hall**.
